root_cause: The GitHub Actions runner could not reach the Ubuntu apt mirror at azure.archive.ubuntu.com:80. The connection attempt to 40.81.13.82:80 timed out after multiple retries. This is a transient network infrastructure issue unrelated to the PR changes (which add RGBtoNV12/BGRtoNV12 operations to the template plugin). The failure is not caused by any code change in the PR.
reproduction_steps: N/A - infrastructure/network issue not reproducible locally
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed Debian Packages job - the network issue is transient and should resolve on retry
If the failure persists, check Azure network status for azure.archive.ubuntu.com availability
prevention_strategies: Consider adding retry logic or fallback mirrors in the Debian package installation step to handle transient apt mirror outages.
